title: 宝塚記念の後に・シンデレラ粉砕

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Cinderella or not, I shall cut down, crush, and blast into oblivion all opposition!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is a beauty that surpasses Cinderella's. It is that of I! T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My prince… Oh, how beautiful you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O holds nothing back and defeats Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may try to adopt the air of a prince, but the Overlord comes through loud and clear. Nothing new there.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… I'm sorry. I finally challenged you in a race, but I couldn't put up a good fight.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: At the very last minute… all I could think was how I can't possibly win.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your ego fails to be the source of your effort. That may be your weak point, Doto.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So find your source in me! Strengthen yourself and strive to rouse my competitive spirit!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do it for you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! You wish to become my eternal adversary, do you not? In which case…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You must forget yourself and charge ahead unflinchingly! Just like the others have done!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They look around to see the other racers staring them down with malice in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Opera O recognizes she was their target after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow, everyone's faces… Their eyes… They all look so intense…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But can I really be like that? Could I ever look at you that way?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me well, Doto. I have already declared that I'm moving my pieces on the board toward the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You have until then to consider whether or not you wish to become my eternal adversary.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let us be off, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O turns and leaves the track without batting an eye to the numerous hateful stares aimed at her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A task yet remains for Doto, just as a task yet remains for us.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I may have prevailed over her… but I fell a breath short of claiming the spotlight. Do you know why?
choice_data_list: You felt the pressure on you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Indeed. Heh, you never miss a beat.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It proved quite difficult to run like the Overlord whilst in the sights of every racer there.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. Saw through that as well, did you? Of course not. The path of a king is no cakewalk!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As the Overlord, I have to surpass these walls.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We have until fall to contemplate the difficulties. With our heads put together, we will find a solution, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall arrive at the Japan Cup with all the majesty befitting a ruler for this nation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the attack on the Overlord that Grass Wonder predicted has become a real threat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to find a way to help her push through and establish the foundation for her dynasty.
